coverage_notes: The paper reports text-formatted biological prompts and multiple DNAm prompt schemas, but no arm-level representation comparison or biological-input removal/corruption test. The resulting system, Longevity-LLM v0.1, operates within a single 14-billion-parameter Qwen3 model
TCGA pairwise progression-free survival comparisons (which patient lived longer without progression?).
The regression variant of the NHANES time-to-death task yielded the lowest MAE among all tested systems (51.0 months).
The  base  Qwen3 architecture, originally designed to process natural text, has proven fully sufficient for a task that previously required a dedicated statistical model.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors state that a standard natural-text Qwen3 architecture is sufficient for DNAm age prediction without dedicated biological-processing architecture.
